title: PRD0062 34B — Enforce effective Book Homework windows

resolvedProviderBlocker.result: Each committed Homework authority now contains a validated frozen per-placement policy snapshot bound to policy identity, Placement, Activity, and Activity Version; legacy missing snapshots fail closed.

implementation.authority: Trusted Worker server time plus committed student-specific Homework authority, frozen per-placement policy, schedule hierarchy, extensions, and current runtime attempts.
implementation.failClosedLegacyBehavior: Missing, malformed, stale, mismatched, or legacy policy snapshots return unavailable and never fall back to browser time, route state, or cached projections.

buildHarness.observed: The x64 source-mirroring harness emitted no product diagnostics and exceeded 300 seconds; focused TypeScript-loading test suites and Wrangler compilation passed.

boundaryCoverage: context-scoped document authorization without PDF page narrowing

studentBrowserProof.security: The browser consumes a typed Delivery-shaped server projection. Query route state, clientNow=2099, forged state, and stale prior projection never decide the window.

reopenedMaxAttemptsRepair.reason: The original completion boolean treated the first terminal attempt as exhaustion even when the frozen Homework policy permitted another attempt.
reopenedMaxAttemptsRepair.authorityChange: The schedule authority now derives attemptsUsed from distinct current terminal attempts in the exact recipient, binding, context, Placement, Activity, and Activity Version scope, then computes attemptsRemaining and attemptsExhausted against maxAttempts.
reopenedMaxAttemptsRepair.completionSeparation: A first terminal attempt still produces completed/review state, while autosave and submit remain permitted until the attempt limit is exhausted. Review-required remains reviewable and ungraded.

independentReview.focusedVerification: Root 4 files/31 tests and Cloudflare selected 8 files/62 tests passed; targeted ESLint and final Wrangler dry-run passed.
independentReview.finding: No remaining acceptance blocker. Exact binding/revision propagation, terminal-attempt exhaustion, retry authority, trusted submit replay after exhaustion, stable two-row aggregation, preview readback, fail-closed rollback, and cleanup passed.
independentReview.caveat: Non-blocking coverage gaps remain for malformed attempt-policy boundary matrices, multi-interaction attempt counting, autosave replay after exhaustion, and greater-than-50/unlimited query behavior. The general npm build remains classified as the previously observed x64 source-mirroring harness stall; focused TypeScript-loading suites and Wrangler compilation passed with no product diagnostics.
